product_overview: Bottomless is a minimalist, zero-stimulation infinite descent web app for stress relief and mindfulness. It combines endless physics-driven scrolling, harmonic soundscapes, breath pacing, and immersive depth landmarks without accounts, ads, or trackers.
core_goals: Provide an instant, zero-friction mindfulness experience with no sign-in or permissions.
Deliver a calming infinite descent interaction with smooth inertia physics and safe mobile controls.
Offer procedural audio, breath pacing, themes, and somatic prompts to support stress reduction.
Persist user-discovered landmarks locally for offline atlas exploration.
Support responsive PWA usage across desktop, tablet, and mobile with strong privacy and performance guarantees.

features.name: Physics-Driven Infinite Descent
features.description: A calm, uninterrupted vertical descent experience with parachute-like inertia, touch and mouse scrolling, keyboard control, Zen Float mode, and a smooth glide back to surface.
user_flows: User loads the app and uses mouse wheel or touch drag to descend -> GET / app renders the current depth and velocity -> App applies inertia and damping -> User continues descending through an endless world -> App updates depth, zone, and landmark proximity in real time

User is at depth and wants hands-free calm motion -> User taps the Float control -> App enables Zen Float auto-descent -> GET / app continues steady descent at the configured glide speed -> User taps Float again to stop auto-descent

User reaches a point where they want to return to the surface -> User presses Home or taps the Surface button -> App initiates smooth glide-to-surface physics -> GET / app animates deceleration toward 0 m -> App returns to the surface state

User input is too aggressive or unsupported -> User performs an extreme scroll or invalid key input -> App clamps motion to terminal velocity and damping rules -> GET / app remains responsive without error or overscroll failures

features.name: 108Hz Harmonic Audio Synthesizer
features.description: Procedural browser-based audio that generates a calming drone, pink-noise wind, and selectable presets with a mute-by-default posture and volume control.
user_flows: User opens the sound popover and selects a preset -> GET / app displays available sound options -> User chooses harmonic108, singingBowl, or deepAbyss -> App starts the Web Audio synthesis chain -> User hears the selected procedural soundscape with the current volume

User wants quiet and disables audio -> User taps the sound toggle or presses M -> App mutes the master gain -> GET / app continues visual descent with no playback -> User can re-enable sound later without reloading

User selects an invalid or unavailable sound option -> User opens the sound menu and chooses an unsupported preset -> App rejects the selection and keeps the current preset active -> GET / app remains stable and preserves audio state -> User can choose a valid preset afterward

features.name: Theme Customization
features.description: A root-level theme system that switches the interface between Void, Mist, and Tide palettes for different lighting environments and preferences.
user_flows: User opens the theme popover and chooses a palette -> GET / app displays Void, Mist, and Tide options -> User selects a valid theme -> App applies the theme variables immediately -> User sees the UI recolor without page reload

User is in a bright room and wants a lighter palette -> User opens theme controls -> User selects Mist or Tide -> App updates background, text, and mote colors -> GET / app retains the selection for continued browsing
User taps outside the theme popover without choosing -> GET / app shows the theme menu backdrop -> User dismisses the popover by tapping the backdrop -> App closes the menu with no theme change

User attempts to choose an unsupported theme -> User selects a non-existent theme identifier -> App ignores the invalid choice and keeps the active theme -> GET / app continues rendering with the previous palette

features.name: 5.5s Resonant HRV Breath Pacer
features.description: A visual breathing companion that animates a concentric circle through a 5.5-second inhale and 5.5-second exhale cycle to encourage slow, regulated breathing.
user_flows: User taps the Breathe control or presses B -> App opens the breath pacer and starts the 5.5-second cycle -> GET / app renders the expanding and contracting circle -> User follows the visual rhythm during descent
User wants to stop the breathing guide -> User taps Breathe again -> App pauses the pacer animation -> GET / app returns to the default HUD without the pacer overlay

User opens the breath pacer while another overlay is active -> GET / app shows the current modal/ppopover state -> User activates Breathe -> App prioritizes the pacer display without breaking the descent state -> User continues breathing and scrolling

User provides repeated toggle input rapidly -> User taps Breathe multiple times quickly -> App debounces state changes and keeps a stable cycle state -> GET / app avoids visual glitching or inconsistent timer behavior

features.name: Spatial Landmarks & Discovery Atlas
features.description: An interactive atlas of inverted milestones and geological depths that appear as the user descends, with discoveries saved locally and accessible through an atlas modal.
user_flows: User descends past a milestone depth -> GET / app evaluates landmark proximity -> App reveals the milestone card and somatic whisper -> User continues downward and the discovery is stored locally in the atlas

User opens the Atlas modal to review discoveries -> User taps the Atlas control -> GET / app loads the discovered landmark list from localStorage -> App displays saved milestones and depth lore -> User taps a discovered entry to jump to that depth

User is near a landmark on a supported device -> App detects proximity within the trigger threshold -> GET / app fires a subtle haptic pulse where available -> User receives tactile confirmation while continuing descent
User has no saved discoveries yet -> User opens the Atlas modal on first use -> GET / app reads an empty localStorage set -> App shows an empty-state atlas with no discovered landmarks

User attempts to jump to an undiscovered depth -> User selects a locked or unseen landmark in the atlas -> App blocks direct navigation to that entry -> GET / app keeps the user at the current depth and continues normal descent

features.name: Mobile-First Dock & Root Popovers
features.description: A responsive fixed bottom dock and root-level popover system designed to avoid clipping, support safe-area insets, and make touch interactions reliable on mobile devices.
user_flows: User opens the app on a mobile device -> GET / app renders the fixed dock with safe-area padding -> User taps a dock action such as Sound, Theme, or Atlas -> App opens the corresponding root popover above the overlay -> User dismisses it by tapping outside the panel

User interacts with the dock on a touchscreen -> User taps a control pill -> App handles pointerup and click without 300ms delay -> GET / app executes the action immediately -> User sees instant response on mobile
User opens a popover and wants to close it quickly -> GET / app shows the popover backdrop -> User taps the backdrop area -> App dismisses the popover and restores the dock

User attempts to interact with a clipped or obscured popover state -> User opens a menu while the viewport is constrained -> App keeps popovers mounted at root z-index to avoid clipping -> GET / app preserves visibility and touch access across viewport sizes

code_summary.description: A minimalist, zero-stimulation infinite descent web application for stress relief and mindfulness.

features.name: Physics-Driven Infinite Descent
features.description: Parachute inertia physics with terminal velocity of 24 m/s and 0.92 damping. Supports touch scrolling, mouse wheel, Zen Float toggle, and glide to surface.

features.name: 108Hz Harmonic Audio Synthesizer
features.description: Procedural sound engine generating 108Hz drone, Pink Noise, and Void silence with volume controls and preset selection popover.

features.name: Theme Customization
features.description: Switching between Void (OLED Black), Deep Sea (Navy Abyss), and Bioluminescence (Ethereal Cyan/Emerald) via root-hoisted popovers.

features.name: 5.5s Resonant HRV Breath Pacer
features.description: Visual breathing pacer animating an expanding and contracting circle synchronized to a 5.5-second inhalation/exhalation cycle.

features.name: Spatial Landmarks & Discovery Atlas
features.description: 21 inverted depth milestones from 0m to 10,000,000m+ with proximity triggers, somatic whispers, and an interactive Atlas modal.

features.name: Mobile-First Dock & Root Popovers
features.description: Fixed dock with safe-area padding (env(safe-area-inset-bottom)), root popovers with z-index 1500, and backdrop touch dismiss to prevent clipping on mobile.
